entry.title: SPARQL-Planned Single-Hop Traversal over a Live Knowledge Graph for Multi-Hop Question Answering
entry.summary: Interleaves dense retrieval with question-specific Wikidata traversal, parsing LLM-generated SPARQL into reliable single-hop lookups and using discovered bridge entities to refine the next search.

entry.title: fork() for Agents: Agent Kernel for Non-blocking LLM Orchestration
entry.summary: Agent-Kernel retries a failed branch and its dependents while preserving completed sibling work, and passes parent outputs into downstream prompts without blocking independent tasks.

entry.title: WK-Drift: Benchmarking Procedural Memory Maintenance under World Knowledge Drift
entry.summary: WK-Drift benchmarks how agents maintain stored procedures when the world changes; targeted graph updates raise post-drift clinical accuracy from 37.5% to 64.0% with known drift events.

entry.title: APEX-EM: Non-Parametric Online Learning for Autonomous Agents via Structured Procedural-Episodic Experience Replay
entry.summary: APEX-EM introduced procedural knowledge graphs for LLM agent memory: its typed Procedural Knowledge Graph stores complete solution traces and retrieves them by meaning, operation structure, and graph traversal, with no model retraining.

entry.title: Routed Graph Handoff: Adaptive Format Selection for Multi-Agent LLM Delegation
entry.summary: An extra classifier call picks per task whether one AI agent sends work to another as a dependency graph or as prose, gaining 12.7 points on τ-retail and preventing a 14.6-point loss on AppWorld.

entry.title: APEX-MEM: Agentic Semi-Structured Memory with Temporal Reasoning for Long-Term Conversational AI
entry.summary: APEX-MEM uses an append-only property graph of temporally grounded, entity-centric events and a multi-tool retrieval agent to resolve evolving information at query time.

entry.title: Efficient Fine-Tuning Large Language Models for Knowledge-Aware Response Planning
entry.summary: The paper fine-tunes a question-answering model twice, once with retrieved web text and once without, so it can fall back on what it already knows; end-to-end accuracy rises 7.40% over a ranking baseline.

entry.title: Question-Context Alignment and Answer-Context Dependencies for Effective Answer Sentence Selection
entry.summary: Instead of pasting neighboring sentences onto the question, this model matches question words to context words and builds a small sentence graph, raising top-1 answer accuracy on WikiQA from 68.09 to 74.16.

entry.title: Controlled Text Generation with Hidden Representation Transformations
entry.summary: CHRT steers a language model away from toxic or negative text by editing its internal number vectors, cutting toxicity from 0.827 to 0.085 while adding only 0.01 seconds per generation.

entry.title: Cross-Lingual Knowledge Distillation for Answer Sentence Selection in Low-Resource Languages
entry.summary: The paper trains answer-ranking models for languages with no labeled data by copying the soft scores of a strong English model, lifting Arabic accuracy on translated WikiQA from 64.2 to 76.3.

entry.title: WDRASS: A Web-scale Dataset for Document Retrieval and Answer Sentence Selection
entry.summary: WDRASS introduced a web-scale open-domain question answering dataset with 64,000 questions and 800,000+ labeled passages and sentences drawn from 30 million documents.

entry.title: ACM -- Attribute Conditioning for Abstractive Multi Document Summarization
entry.summary: Adds a sentiment and polarity classifier to a news multi-document summarizer so it sticks to one viewpoint, raising the word-overlap ROUGE-1 score on MultiNews from 42.99 to 50.12 versus GraphSum.

entry.title: Training Mixed-Domain Translation Models via Federated Learning
entry.summary: Five domain-specific translation models use federated learning to build a mixed-domain neural machine translation system without pooling their data, with a method for selecting impactful parameters to control communication bandwidth.

entry.title: Communication-Efficient Federated Learning for Neural Machine Translation
entry.summary: To train translation models across separate data owners, the authors share only a few small added "Controller" layers, cutting exchanged parameters about six times with average translation quality slightly above the matched baseline.

entry.title: Deep Reinforced Self-Attention Masks for Abstractive Summarization (DR.SAS)
entry.summary: Adds a reinforcement-learning agent that decides which input words a summarizer should ignore, raising the word-overlap score ROUGE-1 on CNN/Daily Mail news from 40.79 to 41.89 against fine-tuned UniLM.

entry.title: BERTQA -- Attention on Steroids
entry.summary: Adds two extra attention layers to BERT so a question and its passage look at each other directly, which lifts SQuAD 2.0 dev F1 from 74.15 to 77.03 on the base model.
